name: Hydroxyzine 25 mg 25 Tablets
description: Hydroxyzine 25 mg is a first-generation antihistamine primarily used to treat anxiety and itching caused by allergies. Due to its sedative properties, it is also used as a calming agent before or after medical procedures. It is sold under various brand names, and the 25-tablet presentation is a common option. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
